name: PhotoEZ Lite
author: ejstech

sections.description:
PhotoEZ Lite is the easiest way to share watermarked proof galleries with photography clients and collect their selections — all from your WordPress dashboard.

How it works:

  1. Create a gallery and upload your proof images
  2. Share the secure client link with your client
  3. Your client views the watermarked proofs and selects their favorites
  4. You receive an email notification when selections are submitted
  5. View the selections in your dashboard and begin editing

Free Features:

  • Unlimited galleries
  • Watermarked proof images to protect your work
  • Secure, token-protected client gallery links
  • Client photo selection with visual feedback
  • Email notification when client submits selections
  • Admin dashboard with gallery status overview
  • Lightbox for full-size photo preview
  • Gallery header/cover image with share panel
  • Admin header image crop tool — frame any proof as a wide banner so the gallery cover fits perfectly on client pages
  • Dark/Light gallery theme toggle for client-facing proofing galleries

Upgrade to PhotoEZ Pro for:

  • Final high-resolution delivery to clients
  • ZIP download for clients
  • Custom branded watermark (upload your own PNG)
  • WooCommerce integration for photo upsell purchases
  • Remove “Powered by PhotoEZ Lite” branding
  • Priority support
  • PhotoEZ Booking Addon — automated client booking with Stripe payments
  • PhotoEZ Contracts Addon — automatic contract signing at booking

Upgrade to PhotoEZ Pro →
sections.installation:
1. Upload the photoez-lite folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to PhotoEZ Lite in your admin menu to get started
  4. Create your first gallery under PhotoEZ Lite → Galleries
sections.faq:
How do clients access their gallery?

After you upload proof images to a gallery, copy the client link from the gallery edit screen and send it to your client. The link includes a secure token — no login required.

Can clients download photos?

In PhotoEZ Lite, clients can view and select photos but cannot download originals. Final high-resolution delivery is available in PhotoEZ Pro.

What does the watermark look like?

PhotoEZ Lite applies a “PROOF” text watermark across all proof images to protect your work. You can upload a custom branded watermark PNG in PhotoEZ Pro.

Is WooCommerce required?

No. PhotoEZ Lite works without WooCommerce. WooCommerce integration for photo purchase upsells is a Pro feature.

Can I upgrade later?

Yes! Your galleries and data are fully compatible with PhotoEZ Pro. Simply install and activate PhotoEZ Pro and all your existing galleries will be there.

Can I customize the gallery header image?

Yes. Click Set as header on any proof image, then use the built-in Crop header tool to frame it for the wide banner at the top of the client gallery. The crop is saved at the correct aspect ratio so headers look great on every screen size.
sections.changelog:
1.0.6

  • NEW: Client photo notes — clients can leave a short editing note on each photo they select. Notes appear with their selections on the gallery edit screen and in the new-selections email. On/off globally in Settings, with a per-gallery override.
  • NEW: Styled “Selections Submitted” confirmation screen on the client gallery, showing session, photographer, photo count and status.
  • NEW: Clients are asked to confirm if they submit fewer photos than their package includes.
  • FIX: Client selections are now saved as a complete set instead of one request per click, so rapid selecting can no longer lose photos or leave the counter disagreeing with the gallery.
  • FIX: Client galleries are excluded from full-page caching, which could replay a stale copy of a visitor’s selections.
  • FIX: The Client Selections panel now only shows photos the client has actually submitted.
  • FIX: The proof media picker is restricted to images, so non-image files (PSD, RAW) can no longer be chosen as proofs.
  • CSS and JS assets are versioned by file modification time, so updates reach browsers without a plugin version bump.

1.0.5

  • NEW: Dark/Light gallery theme toggle for client-facing proofing galleries (PhotoEZ Lite → Settings)
  • NEW: Admin header image crop tool — set any proof as the gallery cover and crop it to a wide banner
  • NEW: Client gallery header/cover image and share gallery panel
  • Admin Galleries page redesigned with card layout
  • Client gallery UI improvements (filenames, submitted banner, wider 80vw layout)
  • Responsive proof grid with more columns on wide screens
  • Fix missing gallery thumbnails on the admin Galleries page
  • Guard against running alongside PhotoEZ Pro

1.0.4

  • Misc. stabilization fixes

1.0.3

  • Misc. stabilization fixes

1.0.2

  • NEW: Admin header image crop tool — set any proof as the gallery cover and crop it to a wide banner so the client gallery header fits perfectly
  • Fix missing gallery thumbnails on the admin Galleries page
  • Add client gallery header/cover image and share gallery panel (matches PhotoEZ Pro)
  • Fix narrow client galleries by using 80vw (80% of browser width) instead of 80% of theme content column
  • Responsive proof grid with more columns on wide screens

1.0.1

  • Admin Galleries page redesigned to match PhotoEZ Pro card layout
  • Client gallery UI aligned with PhotoEZ Pro (dark theme, filenames, submitted banner)
  • Client galleries widened to 80% page width

1.0.0

  • Initial release
